definitions.explanation: Music performed on instruments, as opposed to vocal music ({声楽|せいがく}). Used mainly in music education and classical music.

examples.japanese: {器楽|きがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{器楽|きがく}⟦{合奏|がっそう}→合奏：16325_gassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We played in an instrumental ensemble in music class.

examples.japanese: {音大|おんだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{声楽|せいがく}→声楽：12157_seigaku⟧{科|か}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{器楽|きがく}{科|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{器楽|きがく}{科|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧や⟦{弦楽器|げんがっき}→弦楽器：07534_gengakki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: Music colleges have vocal and instrumental departments; in the instrumental department students study piano, strings and so on.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {器楽|きがく}{曲|きょく}: an instrumental piece
- {器楽|きがく}⟦{合奏|がっそう}→合奏：16325_gassou⟧: instrumental ensemble (a standard school music activity)
- {器楽|きがく}{科|か}: instrumental music department

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{声楽|せいがく}→声楽：12157_seigaku⟧: vocal music, its counterpart
- インストゥルメンタル / インスト: an instrumental track (pop music); {器楽|きがく} is the word for classical and school contexts
